stats.title: How to Dress Quiet Luxury (No Matter Your Budget)

structure.what_is_said: "You might think looking refined and expensive requires a wardrobe full of designer pieces, but the most elegant people aren't dressed loudly at all. Quiet luxury is a timeless way of dressing that makes you look put together and effortlessly expensive without logos or trends."
structure.how_it_is_shown: 4 FULL creator clips, each held 4-5.5 s, dissolves; no text

structure.what_is_said: "In today's video, we're revealing the exact wardrobe essentials that create that quiet luxury look. Pieces that instantly elevate your style, no matter your budget."
structure.how_it_is_shown: White card with script "In Today's Video.." (0:18-0:20), FULL creator clip, FULL cinematic wine clip

structure.what_is_said: "And by the end of this video, you'll have everything you need to refine your style with ease. Let's get started."
structure.how_it_is_shown: "Episode 17" + script "7 Quiet Luxury Essentials" over 2 FULL clips

structure.what_is_said: "Structured neutral tops."
structure.how_it_is_shown: White card "1. Structured Neutral Tops"

structure.what_is_said: A designer top is not needed; a high-quality top with a good fit looks more refined than loud/logo-heavy; it's a category (crisp cotton tee, relaxed button-down, linen shirt, simple blouse); fabric, fit and restraint; warm vs cool seasons; elevates trousers, denim, skirts. "So stunning."
structure.how_it_is_shown: $2300 vs $50 comparison card; separated photos on white; caramel row; product cut-outs one per word; photo + caramel quote card; small rows building one per item; rounded centred outfit-change reels

structure.what_is_said: "The second essential is a well-tailored pair of trousers."
structure.how_it_is_shown: White card "2. Tailored Trousers"

structure.what_is_said: Tailoring makes an outfit intentional; clean silhouettes (straight, wide, taper with ankle cut), mid to high rise, avoid overly tight or exaggerated; shades black/grey/navy/cream/beige; pair with simple tops; dress down or up.
structure.how_it_is_shown: Caramel+centre reel, row built 1-2-3, small rows built one per cut, cream background + rounded outfit-change reels (2:03-2:15, 2:34-2:41), trouser cut-outs one per colour

structure.what_is_said: "And this is where knowing what truly flatters you makes the biggest difference. The most well-dressed women aren't guessing. They understand which cuts and proportions work best for them. If you'd like to stop guessing and finally discover the exact pant and clothing styles that suit your body along with your best colors, hairstyles, timeless beauty, and style secrets, you can access our personal stylist guides down below. They're sent instantly to your email after access."
structure.how_it_is_shown: Caramel reel, row of 5, photo + caramel quote card, then 6 darkened FULL clips with "Check The Description / Personal Stylist Guide" (2:59-3:12)

structure.what_is_said: Denim can look refined: clean cut, simple wash, no distressed/very light washes, straight or relaxed; works like tailoring.
structure.how_it_is_shown: Rows built one panel at a time, cream + rounded outfit-change reel, top-down outfit reels

structure.what_is_said: "The next essential is delicate jewelry."
structure.how_it_is_shown: White card "3. Delicate Jewelry"

structure.what_is_said: Jewellery quietly pulls the look together; small hoops, fine chains, subtle studs, delicate bracelet; layering if balanced; bold earrings -> rest minimal; layered necklaces -> rest simple; minimal and consistent = signature.
structure.how_it_is_shown: 4 FULL jewellery close-ups (1 s each), small row built one per item, cream + rounded jewellery reel, photo + caramel double-quote card, row with an older woman, caramel+centre close-up reel

structure.what_is_said: "And don't worry, we'll link a few of our favorite jewelry pieces and websites below."
structure.how_it_is_shown: Darkened FULL jewellery clip with "Check The Description for Links to / Elegant Jewelry"

structure.what_is_said: "The next essential is a timeless layer."
structure.how_it_is_shown: White card "4. Timeless Layers"

structure.what_is_said: Coats, blazers, jackets set the tone; tailored blazer, wool coat, trench; wool, cotton, cashmere; one well-made sweater; in warm months a light jacket or a knit over the shoulders.
structure.how_it_is_shown: Row built to 6, layer cut-outs one per word, fabric circles one per word, 3-panel rows with a tutorial reel in the centre (knit over shoulders), full-width caramel quote

structure.what_is_said: "Next are your shoes."
structure.how_it_is_shown: White card "5. Shoes"

structure.what_is_said: Simple wearable shoes: loafers, ballet flats, clean minimal sneakers, classic boots; avoid chunky soles, flashy details, extreme shapes; a few timeless pairs make styling easier. "So pretty."
structure.how_it_is_shown: Rounded shoe try-on reels, shoe cut-outs one per word, rows built, cream row of the shoes to avoid (no marks), 3 panels with a captioned shoe-styling reel in the centre

structure.what_is_said: "Next is color, a key part of quiet luxury."
structure.how_it_is_shown: White card "6. Color"

structure.what_is_said: Neutrals are the foundation; colour and print are fine with balance; ground prints with neutral shoes and simple accessories; complementary pairings (black and gold, navy and brown, blue and white, taupe and brown); monochrome; colours that suit your natural colouring.
structure.how_it_is_shown: Rounded coat-change reel 7 s, two full-width caramel quotes, rows of 3 (with celebrity-like photos), small row built one per colour pair, caramel monochrome reel

structure.what_is_said: "If you'd like help discovering the shades that suit your skin tone and overall palette best, we've linked our style guides in the description below."
structure.how_it_is_shown: FULL colour-draping clip (no text), then cream + centre outfit-change reel

structure.what_is_said: "When your wardrobe is built around colors that work well together, getting dressed becomes easier and your outfits look cohesive without feeling styled. Quiet luxury isn't about limiting yourself..."
structure.how_it_is_shown: Cream + centre reel, row built, full-width caramel quote

structure.what_is_said: "The final essential is the right bag."
structure.how_it_is_shown: White card "7. Just The Right Bags!"

structure.what_is_said: You don't need 20 designer bags; a few: structured everyday bag (medium tote / top handle, neutral), simple evening bag (clutch / compact shoulder bag), versatile handbag; clean lines, subtle hardware, colours that work. "Beautiful."
structure.how_it_is_shown: FULL clip, caramel bag reel 9 s, 3-panel rows, 4.5 s empty caramel, small row of bag close-ups built one by one

structure.what_is_said: "We'll link some of our favorite bags, clothing, and quiet luxury essentials below as well."
structure.how_it_is_shown: 2 FULL clips with "Check The Description / Quiet Luxury Essentials"

structure.what_is_said: "There are so many ways to achieve that quiet luxury expensive look, so let us know if you'd like a part two."
structure.how_it_is_shown: 4 FULL mood clips

structure.what_is_said: "And thank you so much for watching. If you enjoyed this video or found it helpful, leaving a like or a comment truly means so much to us. Be sure to check the description for instant access to the personal stylist guide if you'd like to elevate your style even further. And please chat with us in the comments."
structure.how_it_is_shown: FULL clips; guide text + URL over the last one (8:54-9:00)

structure.what_is_said: "We genuinely love hearing from you. Until next time. Bye, my loves."
structure.how_it_is_shown: FULL clip: woman in front of a Cartier store turns and walks away
